name: Mitsuzuri Ayako
source:
A stellar athlete, and captain of the archery club. Ayako and [url=/c34]Rin[/url] are friends and actively competing to see who will be the first to snag a boyfriend. Ayako is also friends with Shirou and has a one-sided rivalry with him.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Fate/stay_night_characters]Wikipedia[/url]]
